author: MMAFighting
text:
Natália Silva claps back at Valentina Shevchenko's response to winning the #UFC title:

"Keep it warm? She wasn’t even keeping it warm herself. She would take a year between fights. She was fighting once a year, and now she’s talking about keeping the belt warm?"

(🎥 @guicruzzz)
